571 reviews. 4.7 stars. And it sits ON the water at Rạch Vẹm.

Nhà Trên Biển - Joy Adventures is a restaurant AND a boat launch to Starfish Beach. Eat seafood over the sea, then hop a boat to one of Phu Quoc's most iconic sandbars. Two experiences, one stop.

Prices run $15-30 per person. Worth every cent.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
